preparation.scope: Current cooperative32 fixed batch kernel versus direct early loads of four or eight state rows before history work, or moving history after state stores. All remain 32 columns, GRF256 and SLM1024. Same four ordered 32-term FMA chains, reduction order, and history layout. Generic and single-layer paths unchanged.
preparation.rule_before_measurement: Three fixed candidates, 85 checks each. One shape-local A/B/A/B/A screen; select one candidate passing BOTH capacities by combined geometric throughput, then two fresh confirmation processes. Each positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift <=3%) and positive pooled gain; each capacity geometric throughput gain >=1% in screen and confirmation. No resampling or model-speedup claim. An eligible winner is cleaned up and independently rebuilt for another screen/two confirmations plus existing GDN regression and native audit before source adoption.
